text:
- **Owner questions and replies:** Ask-tool questions now appear on the site, and the first answer from the site or chat is used. A change removes the reply wait and inbox commands; owner replies reach a session by push alone.
- **Pull request CI:** Pull requests run only the Go tests their changed files can affect, and macOS runs only the OS-dependent ones. MacOS compute fell on several pull requests, but the run time is still above target.
- **Agent behavior:** Agents no longer ask permission before opening a project, sprint or task the owner requested. Claude Code's auto memory is now off in this repo.
- **Agent guidance checks:** AGENTS.md is now a short map that every runtime reads in full. A check grades it on every pull request; work on repeatable verdicts is in progress.
